d:
The Spurs defeated the Kings, 130-103 tonight in San Antonio. Victor Wembanyama contributed a team-high 29 points to go with 5 blocks 10 rebounds and 2 steals, with Julian Champagnie of the Spurs adding an additional 26 points (9-14 FG, 8-13 3P) in the game. De'Andre Hunter finished with a team-high 24 points along with 6 rebounds for the Kings in the losing effort. The Spurs improve their record to 2-2 with the win, while the Kings fall to 0-4 for the season.
